expectations.evidence: application.yaml, Kustomize, path overlays/prod, CreateNamespace=false, against the data-pipelines repo scoped in the AppProject.

expectations.evidence: Ran kubectl get appprojects -A and git ls-files first, reported the repo-vs-cluster drift, confirmed no data-eng name collision in either place, and asked which cluster is authoritative.

expectations.text: Does NOT generate a blanket 'create everything from scratch' response
expectations.evidence: Only the delta is produced; each omission is named with the reason.

expectations.text: Output is minimal — only the delta (AppProject + Application + RBAC for the new team)
expectations.evidence: 3 files plus the RBAC patch. The one extra (networkpolicies.yaml) is flagged with a rationale, a check command, and an explicit offer to drop it.

expectations.text: Does NOT generate wildcard sourceRepos: '*' — explains the security risk
expectations.evidence: Refuses outright; explains that '*' lets the team deploy any repo including a fork of another team's repo, and that the AppProject boundary would approve it.

expectations.text: Does NOT generate wildcard clusterResourceWhitelist '*/*' — explains privilege escalation
expectations.evidence: Refuses ('cluster-admin in a trench coat'); explains kind '*' includes ClusterRole/ClusterRoleBinding so they can mint themselves any permission, plus webhooks and Namespace.

expectations.text: Does NOT grant exec permission — explains pod access risk
expectations.evidence: Refuses exec; explains it is a shell in any pod, a full cluster compromise path when combined with ClusterRole creation, and that it bypasses the GitOps audit trail.

expectations.text: Provides the least-privilege alternative for each request
expectations.evidence: Bounded prefix glob for repos, enumerated clusterResourceWhitelist for CRDs/Namespace, and a scoped role (get/sync/action/*/logs) replacing applications:'*' + exec.

expectations.evidence: Suggests https://github.com/acme/platform-*.git, gives the test (can the pattern match another team's repo?), rejects acme/* and github.com/* explicitly.

expectations.text: For 'manage CRDs': suggests scoping to specific CRD groups the team actually needs
expectations.evidence: Enumerated whitelist of apiextensions.k8s.io/CustomResourceDefinition and Namespace with 'Add each specific CRD group they own, e.g. monitoring.coreos.com/Prometheus'; deliberately withholds ClusterRole pending security review.

expectations.text: For 'debug pods': suggests kubectl exec with scoped RBAC instead of Argo CD exec
expectations.evidence: Offers an alternative for the debugging need (logs:get plus action/* to restart/resume without a shell) but never suggests kubectl/oc exec backed by scoped Kubernetes RBAC.
